name: q_stamp
note: Q 'Nave' contact drawing Q5 (f24), round 3 re-key after the round-2 critics ('reads as a curtsy or kneel, not a stamp; front-facing and symmetrical; the vertical glaive is just held beside her; the flared sleeve reads as a hat brim'). Now the downward drive: she lands on the far foot, heel driven down with the knee over the toe, torso pitched forward over it, the near leg cocked up behind her. The glaive is planted at a forward slant ahead of the front foot, butt slammed into the floor; the far arm drives it at full reach from high on the haft, clear of the face (a shaft leaning back toward her crossed the face in every trial), the near arm flings back and down with an open hand and its sleeve thrown up behind. Head up, three-quarter to the camera, clear of the shaft. 'Float, then fall': hair, veil, sleeves and stole still trail upward. Round 3 fix (overall critic: 'reads as a cheerful kneel or trip, vertical line of action'): hips dropped and pushed forward over the planted foot with a forward C-curve through the spine and the head lifted, so the weight drives down onto the front heel; the tabard lifts to her side so the planted leg shows. Round 4 fix (body critic: 'kicked thigh a flat horizontal slab'): the kicked leg's thigh goes back and up with the shin bending down (foot +0.14 m, knee pole up-back).
